description: Panda3D command-line tools (egg2bam, bam2egg, pzip/punzip, egg-trans, egg-optchar, egg-palettize, multify, pview, pstats, image-resize, …) for win-x64, linux-x64, osx-x64 and osx-arm64. A self-contained, host-selected toolchain for asset pipelines — each platform's bundle carries the tools plus the Panda shared libraries they need. Consumed via MSBuild: the shipped targets expose  and per-tool paths for the host RID.
